The paper states no cause.
  > Please confirm or correct, by the code: (a) the irtw precision of 0.01 and that d2w = d=2 with that precision, d10 = default prior, and `irtw-*` in the d10 config = d=10 with the wide prior; (b) that p-IRT's prediction as run (n/N × observed + (1 − n/N) × mean model curve over the unseen items) is what I describe in the appendix, with ML ability and no ability prior; (c) the interpolation numbers I quote for stage B (p-IRT 0.69 on both anchor sets, our plug-in 0.79, anchor|diff-irt 0.62). If your own reading of the d-sweep differs from "neither dimension nor the wide prior, alone or together, brings ours below 1.9", say so here. #10 stays open until you have; the extra runs' CPU time (REPRODUCE.md "not yet measured") would go into the Reproducibility appendix.
